sources.snippet: Task: Text Classification (Prompt Injection Detection) Base Model: Microsoft DeBERTa-v3-base Licence: Apache-2.0 Hardware Target: Ascend NPU This model is intended for developers building LLM-based applications, agents, and chatbots. It serves as a pre-processing step to analyse user queries before they reach the primary Large Language Model.
